name: gh_issue_create
description: Create an issue; the number is assigned from the repository's shared issue/PR sequence (POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues)

repo.description: The repository full name in owner/repo form.

assignee.description: Login for the user that this issue should be assigned to.

labels.description: Labels to associate with this issue, as a comma separated list or array of label names.

user.description: Login of the issue author (the authenticated user in the real API). Default: revops-bot.
